description:
Rocket.Chat is open at the login screen in the browser. Log in with:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Navigate to the public channel #release-updates and set (or update) the channel topic to exactly:
"Official Rocket.Chat release tracker - GitHub source: https://github.com/RocketChat/Rocket.Chat/releases"

The topic should be visible in the channel header area after setting it.
